tracking_id.title: A unique 50-character ID that identifies the future dated payment

status.title: Current future dated payment status
status.description:
It only accepts the following values:

`CREATED`: When the future dated payment request is created.

`UNSETTLED`: When the future dated payment has unsettled values.

`SETTLED`:When the future dated payment has been paid in full.

`CANCELED`: When the future dated payment was canceled.

`EXPIRED`: When the future dated payment has expired.

external_account_id.title: External Account identifier
external_account_id.description: A custom account ID that identifies the account within your organization.

division_id.title: Division unique identifier
division_id.description: Division unique identifier generated by Pismo

division_code.title: Division code unique identifier
division_code.description: Code that identifies the division within your organization.

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: Processing code used for posting the future dated payment.

uncleared_funds.title: The balance of the future dated payment funds that was posted on the account pending for clearance or confirmation.

currency.title: A three-letter alphabetic code in ISO 4217 standard that corresponds to the currency used in the earmark transaction

payment_datetime.title: Payment timestamp in RFC 3339 date/time format

settlement_date.title: Settlement date
settlement_date.description: The future dated payment settlement date.

internal_operation.title: Contains the transaction data executed internally

type.title: Type of the internal operation
type.description:
It only accepts the following values:

`INITIAL_PAYMENT`: When future dated payment initial payment request is executed.

`SETTLEMENT`: When the future dated payment is paid partially/fully.

`CANCELATION`: When the future dated payment was canceled.

`EXPIRATION`: When the future dated payment has expired.

tracking_id.title: Tracking number that identifies the transaction

created_at.title: RFC 3339 date/time for the operation creation

metadata.title: Key-value fields that contain relevant data your organization needs to store at Pismo
